summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test plus a non-node input test. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) using the shared venv. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type checking and formatting were checked only by hand (lines are within 88 columns). Nothing was committed.
